brief: ROUTING MEMO: Training parcel. Box 407-B doorways dump you into pocket universes. Deliver to the named recipient on the far side. Timing remains a distribution.

doors.outcomeText: Suburban porch. Mailbox already knows your name. Mild existential humidity.
Storm rooftops. Acid rain on a schedule nobody follows. Deliver anyway.
Unmapped void. Black-hole mail slot where the customer should be.

brief: PRIORITY: Recipient listed as 'definitely a person.' Universe may disagree. Hand off the parcel; argue later.

doors.outcomeText: Quiet block Ω. Sentient traffic waves politely. Do not wave back.
Crystal ruin canopy. Fauna bite schedules. Fragile stamp applies mid-air.
Deep space docklet. Low gravity. Parcel floats; dignity does not.

brief: FRAGILE: CONTAINS A POSSIBILITY. Do not drop, shake, or explain to a Meeseeks. Deliver intact.

doors.outcomeText: Neon alley X-12. Moving walkways with opinions. Customer desk at end.
Sunken post route. Bubbles judge your form. Keep the possibility dry-ish.
Impossible geometry. Meeseeks impatience rated 'helpfully lethal.'

brief: Memo scrap: 'When you do things right, couriers won't be sure which universe did anything at all.' Still get a signature.

doors.outcomeText: Porch-3. Hedge platforms. Cheerful dread. Standard sunny nonsense.
A shipping-floor universe — same belts, wrong sky. Planet Express energy.
Void pocket. Stamp: CALIBRATION GUARANTEED (laugh track optional).

brief: Inter-universe transfer. Signature line: 'N/A (probabilistic).' Customer still expects the box.

doors.outcomeText: Desert highway ∞. Hot wind, hotter deadlines. Hitchhikers are not recipients.
Storm rooftops-9. Portal wind between ledges. Lightning keeps score.
Crystal ruins. Fauna rewrite floor plans hourly. Deliver or be compost.

brief: STATISTICALLY URGENT. Find the customer before this distribution collapses into a sitcom.

doors.outcomeText: Neighborhood Ω. Sentient crosswalks. They mostly point somewhere.
Frozen Outpost-7. Ice is a lifestyle. Friction is a rumor.
Deep space. Low-g platforms. Black-hole slot marked 'OUT / RCPT.'

brief: Cold-route pull across universes you have not visited. J.E.V. insists déjà vu is a supported feature.

doors.outcomeText: Frozen causeway. Odds look honest. That is suspicious.
Underwater post. Pressure spikes. Fish file complaints in triplicate.
Unmapped void. A gap that opens onto a delivery you will make later.

brief: Parcel: 'CONTAINS A POSSIBILITY / KEEP FROZEN / KEEP OPEN-MINDED.' Hand to recipient before it becomes a subplot.

doors.outcomeText: Desert overnight. Heat shimmer bends platforms. Possibility hates sand.
Neon X-12 with portal wind. Meeseeks courier already tried; failed cheerfully.
Impossible geometry. Probability fog + Meeseeks countdown.

brief: Re-route sticky: '8 out of 10 universes recommend us. The other two sued their local recipients.'

doors.outcomeText: Porch again? No — porch adjacent. Dogs bark in stereo across timelines.
Shipping-floor pocket. Belts reverse for 'calibration.' Customer still waiting.
Mispriced void door. Hunt +EV. Trust nothing wearing a smile.

brief: Bulk multiverse transfer. C.O.D. posts on customer receipt. Processing Fee applies (we appreciate your patience across realities).

doors.outcomeText: Neighborhood stroll. Ideal for couriers who dislike cosmic nonsense.
Sunken ruins post. Pressure + crystal fauna. Some vines are older than HR.
Desert gauntlet. HR calls heat shimmer a 'growth opportunity.'

brief: EXECUTIVE CLEARANCE. Origin redacted. Final doorway: impossible geometry. Still deliver to the named recipient.

doors.outcomeText: Impossible hall. Portraits smile without eyes. Customer desk at the vanishing point.
Deep space spine. Low gravity. Smells of toner and destiny.
Labeled 99%. Resolves otherwise. Stamp: TRUST THE MACHINE.

brief: RETURN LOOP. Identical seed → identical universe. You may have delivered here before. You will again. Fry-as-own-grandfather optional.

doors.outcomeText: Familiar porch. Déjà vu is a supported feature.
Neon alley you swear you already ran. Portal wind agrees.
Void again. Do not ask the recipient about their grandfather.
